data.summary: The 8 Google reviews are highly authentic in content, with specific details, varied writing, and credible customer stories. The perfect 5.0 rating and low volume are more indicative of a small, well-regarded local business than review manipulation. The two anonymous HQ reviews are non-substantive and likely auto-generated, but do not detract from the genuine local reviews.
fake_signals: Two HQ reviews are anonymous and contain only business info

positive_evidence: Came back to fix a leak right away

authentic_signals: Specific project details (leaks, mastic, pump rebuild, filters)
Mentions of prior bad experiences with other companies
Mention of business processes (portal, QuickBooks, photos)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews are available, showing a perfect 5.0. No contradictory ratings from other platforms were found.

reviews.text: Leo and his crew have fixed multiple issues with our pool and have done a great job at a very reasonable price! We had a leak in our skimmer, new mastic and he re-built our whole pump. Will definitely use again!
reviews.author: Leah Cardy

reviews.text: HydroCare did a great job repairing my pool concrete and mastic. They were timely and cost efficient. Im hiring them for additional work in the future.  Thanks Leo and team!
reviews.author: Lana LeGrand

reviews.text: So glad we came across Leo and his company. We had issues with the 2 pool companies before coming across Hydrocare Pools. They were not balancing the chemicals right and/or not showing up. When Leo came out the first time, he ran some quick tests, told us the problem and how he was going to fix it. He stayed true to his word and process and got our pool looking great. Unfortunately our pool pump went out due to old age but he was able to give recommendations on either replacing parts or getting a new one. We decided to get a new one, which he was able to install in about 1 hour, thankfully. Ever since then our pool has looked the best it ever has since owning our home. We are very pleased with Leo and his services and will continue using his weekly maintenance services.
reviews.author: Jarrod Ray

reviews.text: Leo has been fantastic. His prices are fair, he communicates well with me and he is trustworthy. My old pool company broke several parts on my pool and tried to hide it, and the pool was always green when they serviced it. Leo has it sparkling blue and I have had no issues since he started working on it. I would highly recommend him to anyone that needs pool services I'm this area.
reviews.author: Katie Cowen

reviews.text: Leo was very professional and knowledgeable while cleaning my pool filters and assisting with tips for overall pool care. If you’re in search of a reputable and reliable pool service please use him, you will not be disappointed.
reviews.author: Marcelo Varela

reviews.text: Leo and team are awesome. They have cleaned my pool for a few years now, are always responsive, reliable and reasonably priced. I love that they send across real time photos of the pool sparking clean, after servicing and payment is handled via the portal where I can use my credit card at no extra charge. Invoices are also super easy to download from thier quickbooks software which is important for my tax records.
reviews.author: Meagan LaBossiere

reviews.text: Since I found Leo our pool has never looked better. I handled our pool maintenance for the last 5 years and found myself up at Leslies every 3 or 4 days for water analysis then back to the house to add chemicals after scrubbing the green alge off the walls. What I like about Leo is  he is a local independent service, he is on time, does what he says he is going and price wise is very reasonable. He also agreed prior to my retaining his services, to take care of our pool while we were on vac (2 1/2 weeks, 3 service calls), which no other pool companies would  agree to do.
reviews.author: Bill Fulmer

reviews.text: Highly recommend! I asked Leo for a quote to replace my pool filter and he was able to do the work the same day for a fair price and he did a great job. Recently I had a leak and he came out right away and fixed it. Anyone needing Richardson Pool Service should give them a call.
reviews.author: Versatile Marketing
